data.exact_reserve_text: The prior years reserve release is often a large contributing factor to the closing year profit but, unusually, the contribution from the prior years was a deficit due largely to the deterioration on General Liability, specifically Florida contractors, noted below. The total of additional reserves added to the prior years for claims notified or IBNR related to this issue amounts to $27.0m net in the calendar year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 11.1m (about 1.4% of opening gross claims outstanding) driven principally by adverse development on prior years' casualty (notably Florida contractors/general liability) together with deterioration on certain marine and aviation large losses. These adverse movements were set against portfolio dynamics and some development releases elsewhere; reserving was also influenced by heightened economic inflation and broader market events during 2022.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross estimates) as the authoritative gross source. Some event impacts and amounts in the report are quoted in USD (not converted). The syndicate has undertaken Part VII transfers and there are reinsurance-to-close and LIC reinsurance arrangements that can distort development patterns; these were considered but the triangle was used as primary gross source. Prior-year specific amounts in the narrative are often reported net of reinsurance; gross quantifications were not always available.
